scripts.lint: pnpm --dir apps/desktop lint && pnpm run build && cargo clippy --workspace --all-targets --all-features -- -D warnings
scripts.test: pnpm run test:web && pnpm run test:rust
scripts.coverage:rust: pnpm run build && cargo tarpaulin --workspace --exclude silversetup-desktop --all-features --fail-under 92 --out Html
scripts.check: pnpm run format:check && pnpm run lint && pnpm run typecheck && pnpm run test
